suggestions: I'm grateful for a merge conflict that resolved itself cleanly instead of eating my whole lunch break.
I'm thankful for the mug of teh tarik my colleague makes without asking, right when the sprint review is about to start.
I'm grateful for the sound of rain on the roof at 5am, loud enough to wake me up gently before the alarm even tries.
I'm thankful for a one-line fix that turned out to be the actual root cause, not just a patch over the symptom.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a landlord who didn't raise the rent this year.
I'm thankful for my mother still packing extra rice for me to bring back to my apartment, like I'm still eighteen.
I'm grateful for an error log that actually told me what went wrong instead of just "undefined is not a function".
I'm thankful for the five minutes of stillness between the last Isha jemaah leaving and the mosque lights going dim.
I'm grateful for a manager who noticed I was burnt out before I said anything.
I'm thankful for the roti canai stall that's somehow still open at 11pm when I didn't eat dinner.
I'm grateful for a weekend with absolutely nothing on the calendar, not even a Slack notification.
I'm thankful for the unit tests I almost skipped writing, because they caught the exact bug I would've shipped.
I'm grateful for my little sister sending a stupid voice note that made me laugh out loud on a bad day.
I'm thankful for a pay cheque that landed on time this month, no excuses, no delays.
I'm grateful for the breeze right before a thunderstorm, the kind that makes the whole street smell like rain.
